role: Absolute continuity and regularity; complementary constructions/source-valid counterexamples

new_claim.statement: Inside the exact target with fixed A=I_3 there is a sequence of smooth compactly supported cap-one iid marginals and a weakly convergent subsequence to another cap-one marginal such that all output interval masses converge uniformly, while liminf output total variation distance is at least 27/128, liminf density L-infinity distance is at least 27/19008, and at radii r_m=pi/(2s_m) the normalized shrinking-interval profile difference has liminf at least 27/(9504*pi). All approximating and limiting output densities are continuous, compactly supported, and bounded by 1/2. Therefore weak/atomless trace cannot be upgraded to normalized small-ball or density convergence; a common C|I| estimate must be proved before the weak limit or via a stronger stability topology.

designated_partner_results_applied.application: Combined with the phase-aligned target family to prove an exact target-level separation between uniform interval-mass convergence and normalized shrinking-interval/density convergence.
